import { type ReactNode, type CSSProperties } from 'react';
import type { OpenChangeDetails } from '@unofficial-krds/contracts';
import { type KrdsLocale } from '../../providers/index.js';
export interface ModalProps {
    locale?: KrdsLocale;
    /** Native popup composition may reuse the modal lifetime with its own public CSS part. */
    contentAttributes?: {
        'data-krds-component'?: string;
        'data-krds-part'?: string;
        className?: string;
        style?: CSSProperties;
    };
    open?: boolean;
    defaultOpen?: boolean;
    onOpenChange?: (details: OpenChangeDetails) => void;
    title: ReactNode;
    titleId?: string;
    description?: ReactNode;
    descriptionId?: string;
    children?: ReactNode;
    actions?: ReactNode | ((close: () => void) => ReactNode);
    trigger?: ReactNode;
    closeOnOutsideClick?: boolean;
    showCloseButton?: boolean;
    closeLabel?: string;
    initialFocusId?: string;
    returnFocusId?: string;
    id?: string;
    /** DateInput owns its specialized entry policy while retaining modal trapping and restoration. */ onEntryFocus?: (dialog: HTMLElement) => void;
}
export declare function Modal(props: ModalProps): import("react").JSX.Element;
